blocks: # Site induction checklist
Before starting work on site, every contractor must complete the steps below.
- Collect a visitor badge from the gatehouse.
- Read the site safety briefing in full.
- Pay particular attention to the lifting plan.
- Note the location of the first aid room.
- Sign the attendance register.
The permit process then runs in the following order.
1. Submit the method statement to the site manager.
2. Wait for written approval.
1. Approval normally takes two working days.
2. Urgent requests can be escalated by telephone.
3. Display the permit at the work area.
1. Replace it if it becomes unreadable.
4. Return the permit when the work is finished.
Anyone unsure about these steps should ask the site manager before proceeding.
1. Report hazards immediately.
2. Keep walkways clear at all times.
3. Wear the protective equipment issued to you.
Thank you for helping to keep the site safe.
